refreshNotes: MY2026 carries over the Spectre and Black Badge Spectre lineup unchanged from MY2025. Pricing rises modestly: Spectre $397,750 base (per KBB; some sources list higher post-options), Black Badge Spectre $467,750. After the federal $7,500 BEV tax credit expired Sept 30, 2025, Rolls-Royce introduced a $5,000 lease credit (down from $7,500) applicable to MY2025 and MY2026 Spectres. Source: https://www.kbb.com/rolls-royce/spectre/ , https://electrek.co/2025/11/11/rolls-royce-gets-in-on-the-ev-price-war-with-new-5000-lease-promo/ , https://www.carsdirect.com/deals-articles/rolls-royce-has-a-5-000-ev-discount
